svg.title: markdl-stack: Pick a spell. Start building.
svg.desc: Mark's mage artwork beside five independent catalog groups: working on a feature, review and verification, fixing a bug, use as needed, and trying out. The spell theme is a metaphor for reusable skills. Trying out contains tools still under evaluation.

g.text: Shape an idea. Craft the feature.
Inspect the craft. Test the spell.
Find the curse. Fix the code.
